title: 第25章 她想成为一个很厉害的人第26章 你证明给我看了
slug: 贵族学院平民盲女怎么成了白月光
lines: 第25章她想成为一个很厉害的人
“我知道是随机的。”江彻放下茶杯，瓷杯与桌面碰撞发出清脆的声响，“但我要查。”
校长没办法，只能连忙点头：“好好好，我一定查，江少您放心……”
“我不仅要查这次的抽签，”江彻的语调沉了几分，继续道：“我还要你保证，第一场无论是谁赢，安怜和沈千尘都必须进入月影回廊。”
校长愣了一下，脸上露出为难的神色：“江少，这个……规则上确实有点……月影回廊的名额只有十个，如果安怜输给了沈千尘，那她就是被淘汰了……”
“规则是死的，人是活的。十个，那就变成十一个。或者，你们也可以改成九个。”
江彻语气平淡，但说出的话却让校长头皮发麻：“我不介意替学院处理这些多余的繁琐手续。”
校长擦着汗，脑子里飞快转动。
江彻是什么人？
江家下一任掌权人，帝都的商业巨头，手底下握着一个庞大的商业帝国，资产横跨武器制造、魔法阵研发、矿产资源贸易三大领域。
但真正让校长忌惮的，不是江彻的钱，是他背后的东西。
江家，是整个洛林大陆最大的火器制造商。
帝国魔法骑士团有七成以上的武器和弹药是从江家的生产线上下来的，边境要塞的防御阵有一半的魔力供给系统是江家提供的，就连皇室卫队的制式装备都是江家的子公司承制的。
这种程度的资源控制力，江彻要是想给他找麻烦，他能麻烦一辈子。
更重要的是……
江彻本人就是个双系SS级的觉醒者。
火系和金系，全攻击属性，纯粹为战斗而生。
他要是真的发了火，别说炸了这个办公室，就是把整个圣罗兰学院炸了，他都有那个本事。
校长咽了口唾沫，干巴巴地开口：“江少，您的意思是……给安怜一个保底名额？”
“保底名额。”江彻重复了一遍这四个字，语气平淡，“也可以这么理解。她赢了，就当是锦上添花。她输了，名额照给。月影回廊的承载上限是五十人，多加一个不会塌。”
校长沉默了几秒，还是点了头：“好。这事儿我来安排。您放心，安怜同学一定会进入月影回廊。”
江彻“嗯”了一声，站起来，朝门口走去。
走到门口时，他停下来，头也不回地说了一句：“还有，把我的人放进擂台边上待命。如果安怜受了重伤，我不保证我不会做什么。”
校长一屁股坐回了椅子上。
他怎么那么命苦……
赛场中央，安怜半跪在地上，大口大口地喘着气。
她身上多了好几处伤，肩膀、手臂、膝盖、腰侧，全是青紫一片。
沈千尘下手没有留情，但他的力度控制得很精妙，每一击都卡在她承受能力的临界点上，疼，但不致命。
她不知道沈千尘为什么这样做。
也许是为了羞辱她，也许是想看她认输求饶，又也许只是他单纯不想让她太早失去战斗力。
安怜撑着地面站起来，膝盖发颤，但好歹是站住了。
第25章她想成为一个很厉害的人
她朝着沈千尘的方向看去，清澈的眼睛里没有恐惧，没有退缩，只有连她自己都没察觉到的倔强。

Chapter 25 She wants to be a very powerful person
"I know it's random." Jiang Che put down the tea cup, and the porcelain cup made a crisp sound when it collided with the table, "But I want to check."
The principal had no choice but to nod quickly: "Okay, okay, I will definitely check. Don't worry, Mr. Jiang..."
"I not only want to check the lottery this time," Jiang Che's tone became more serious as he continued, "I also want you to guarantee that no matter who wins the first round, An Lian and Shen Qianchen must enter the Moon Shadow Corridor."
The principal was stunned for a moment, with a troubled look on his face: "Young Master Jiang, this... the rules are indeed a bit... there are only ten places in the Moon Shadow Corridor. If An Lian loses to Shen Qianchen, then she will be eliminated..."
"Rules are dead, people are alive. If there are ten, then it becomes eleven. Or, you can change it to nine."
Jiang Che's tone was calm, but what he said made the principal's scalp tingle: "I don't mind handling these redundant and cumbersome procedures for the college."
The principal wiped his sweat and his mind was racing.
Who is Jiang Che?
The next person in charge of the Jiang family, a business tycoon in the imperial capital, controls a huge business empire, with assets spanning three major fields: weapons manufacturing, magic circle research and development, and mineral resource trading.
But what really makes the principal fearful is not Jiang Che's money, but what's behind his back.
The Jiang family is the largest firearms manufacturer in the entire Lorraine continent.
More than 70% of the weapons and ammunition of the Imperial Magic Knights come from the Jiang family's production line. Half of the magic supply system for the border fortress defense array is provided by the Jiang family. Even the standard equipment of the Royal Guard is manufactured by the Jiang family's subsidiaries.
With this level of resource control, if Jiang Che wanted to cause trouble for him, he would be in trouble for the rest of his life.
What's more important is...
Jiang Che himself is a dual-system SS-level awakener.
Fire and metal elements, full attack attributes, purely for fighting.
If he really gets angry, not to mention blowing up this office, he will blow up the entire Saint Laurent Academy. He has the ability to do that.
The principal swallowed and said dryly: "Master Jiang, what do you mean... to give An Lian a guaranteed spot?"
"Guaranteed quota." Jiang Che repeated these four words in a calm tone, "It can be understood this way. If she wins, it will be the icing on the cake. If she loses, the quota will be given to her. The upper limit of the Moon Shadow Corridor is fifty people, and one more person will not collapse."
The principal was silent for a few seconds, then nodded: "Okay. I will arrange this matter. Don't worry, An Lian will definitely enter the Moon Shadow Corridor."
Jiang Che said "Yeah", stood up and walked towards the door.
When he reached the door, he stopped and said without looking back: "Also, put my people on the edge of the ring and stand by. If An Lian is seriously injured, I don't guarantee that I won't do anything."
The principal sat back in his chair.
Why is he so miserable...
In the center of the arena, An Lian was half-kneeling on the ground, breathing heavily.
She had several injuries on her body. Her shoulders, arms, knees, and waist were all covered in bruises.
Shen Qianchen was merciless, but his strength was controlled very delicately. Every blow was stuck at the critical point of her endurance. It hurt, but was not fatal.
She didn't know why Shen Qianchen did this.
Maybe it was to humiliate her, maybe he wanted to see her admit defeat and beg for mercy, or maybe he simply didn't want her to lose her fighting ability too early.
An Lian stood up on the ground, her knees trembling, but she managed to stand still.
Chapter 25 She wants to be a very powerful person
She looked in the direction of Shen Qianchen. There was no fear or flinching in her clear eyes, only a stubbornness that even she was unaware of.
